pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a safe surface for gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Wet tiles
   B. Concrete
   C. A mat or soft clean ground
   D. A stony floor

2. Which is true about netball skills? (1 mark)
   A. Passing and catching are needed by every player
   B. Only shooters need to catch
   C. Nobody needs to move
   D. Only the umpire needs to pass

3. To keep the camera steady you should (1 mark)
   A. hold it with both hands and keep elbows near your body
   B. shake it
   C. hold it at arm's length with one finger
   D. throw it

4. What should you do before photographing someone? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at them
   B. Take it secretly
   C. Take photos of strangers only
   D. Ask their permission

5. In ta-te taa taa (rest), how many beats are there? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Five
   C. Three
   D. Two

6. How many secondary colours are there on the basic colour wheel? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Six
   C. Two
   D. Three

7. How should you hold a camera or tablet? (1 mark)
   A. By one corner
   B. With both hands
   C. Over your head
   D. By the lens

8. Where can you get pictures for a montage? (1 mark)
   A. From the sky
   B. Old newspapers and magazines
   C. From a rock
   D. Only from the bank

9. How is flour paste made? (1 mark)
   A. Mix flour and sand
   B. Burn flour
   C. Freeze flour
   D. Mix flour and cold water to a smooth paste, then add hot water while stirring

10. The home note of the melodies in this lesson is (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. d
   C. none of them
   D. r

11. Where should your hands be at the start? (1 mark)
   A. Just behind the start line
   B. Over the line
   C. In your pockets
   D. Far in front of the line

12. Animal games improve (1 mark)
   A. only singing
   B. only reading
   C. only cooking
   D. fitness and health

13. Which is a rule for animal games? (1 mark)
   A. Push others to go faster
   B. Do not push, trip or pull others
   C. Play without looking
   D. Ignore the whistle

14. Why should you sing folk songs from other communities with respect? (1 mark)
   A. They must be changed
   B. They are unimportant
   C. They are part of our shared culture
   D. They are funny

15. Which letter has a descender? (1 mark)
   A. e
   B. k
   C. g
   D. a

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how to prepare and perform a folk song with your class. (5 marks)

17. Describe how partners should give feedback on each other's gymnastics. (3 marks)

18. Explain the meaning of diction and why it matters. (3 marks)

19. State the length of a crotchet and of a quaver in beats. (2 marks)

20. Why do singers use hand signs? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A mat or soft clean ground
   Soft, flat surfaces prevent injuries.

2. A — Passing and catching are needed by every player
   Every player passes and catches during a game.

3. A — hold it with both hands and keep elbows near your body
   A steady hold gives a sharp photograph.

4. D — Ask their permission
   Permission is polite and safe.

5. A — Four
   Each of ta-te, taa, taa and the rest fills one beat, so there are four beats.

6. D — Three
   Orange, green and purple are the three secondary colours.

7. B — With both hands
   Two hands prevent dropping.

8. B — Old newspapers and magazines
   Cut pictures from old papers and magazines.

9. D — Mix flour and cold water to a smooth paste, then add hot water while stirring
   An adult adds hot water to thicken the smooth paste.

10. B — d
   Melodies feel finished when they end on d.

11. A — Just behind the start line
   Hands go on the ground just behind the line.

12. D — fitness and health
   They strengthen muscles and improve stamina.

13. B — Do not push, trip or pull others
   Safety comes first.

14. C — They are part of our shared culture
   Respect helps unity and cultural appreciation.

15. C — g
   The tail of g goes below the baseline.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Choose a song and say the community, type and message. Share roles among soloist, chorus and instrumentalists. Practise pitch, rhythm, tempo and dynamics. Add gestures and expressions. Perform with respect and take a bow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the song, roles, practising, expression and performing respectfully.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watch carefully, say one good thing first, then one thing to improve, and be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Diction is saying the words clearly. It matters because the audience can understand the message of the song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 2 marks for the reason.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A crotchet is one beat and a quaver is half a beat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: To show and remember the height of each note, and to help them sing in tune.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for showing pitch, 1 mark for remembering or singing in tune.
